question: Alphabet printed its headcount in its third-quarter 2025 Form 10-Q (as of September 30, 2025) and again in its 2025 Form 10-K (as of December 31, 2025). How many more employees did Alphabet have at year-end than at the end of the third quarter?

facts.label: As of September 30, 2025, we had 190,167 employees.
As of December 31, 2025, we had 190,820 employees.
